race.comment: SURELY SPECIAL (5) is a durable 9YO gelding who has been superbly placed to win his last 3 starts in the bounce in similar company to what he meets here. He has to shoulder 61kg this time but is capable of winning again. WINTER NIGHTS (2) has continued to improve with more distance this prep and was second by just under 2 lengths on a heavy track here nearly 2 weeks ago. Damian Lane sticks with him, and so do we. SOUL MISTRESS (11) resumes from a spell off a wide draw and has not been seen at any public jump-outs. Look for her to be running on late. OLYMPIAD (4) blew out badly fresh up over 1612m at Kilmore and can be a quick improver in this. Include. CLISTE (6) ran on well fresh up for fourth, and the step up in trip will suit her. Keep safe in all top 4 combos.
